headline.en: 14% weekly rally stalls below the DAO's own $5.96 fair value mark; UNI remains net inflationary at +1.70%/yr with no catalyst resolved.
headline.zh: 单周 +14% 反弹止步于 DAO 自定的 $5.96 公允价锚下方;UNI 仍以 +1.70%/年 运行于净通胀状态,且尚无催化剂落地。

keyChanges.en: Price +14.15% weekly / +7.71% daily to $4.37 on light $18.67M/day volume — momentum without conviction.
Two revenue-accretive proposals entered temp check: v4 Protocol Fees activation and Robinhood Chain fee expansion — neither voted yet.
keyChanges.zh: 两项潜在增收提案进入 temp check(意向征询)阶段:v4 Protocol Fees 激活与 Robinhood Chain 费用扩张,均未进入正式投票。

keyChanges.en: Buyback burns ~3.01M UNI/year against 20M emission — burn covers only 15% of dilution, net emission still +1.70%.
keyChanges.zh: 年化 buyback(回购)销毁约 3.01M UNI,对应 20M 年增发——销毁仅覆盖 15% 的稀释,净通胀 +1.70%。

contrarianObservation.en: If v4 Protocol Fees advances from temp check to on-chain vote within the 1-4 week window, the buyback math flips toward net-neutral and forces a violent rerate. With only $24.25M OI on a $2.75B cap, +0.01% funding, and a mildly-long 1.65 L/S ratio, positioning is nowhere near crowded enough to absorb that surprise — the short side is undefended.
contrarianObservation.zh: 若 v4 Protocol Fees 在 1-4 周窗口内从 temp check 推进到链上投票,回购数学有望翻转至净中性,并触发剧烈重定价。当前 $2.75B 市值上仅 $24.25M OI、funding 仅 +0.01%、L/S 1.65 略偏多——持仓根本不拥挤,空头一侧几乎没有防御,反而是最脆弱的一边。

watchNext.en: Does the v4 Protocol Fees temp check advance to Snapshot? This is the nearest-term revenue catalyst on the calendar.
watchNext.zh: v4 Protocol Fees 的 temp check 是否推进至 Snapshot 投票?这是日程上最近端的收入端催化剂。

watchNext.en: Daily close reclaim of $5.96 (DAO burn-implied fair value) on rising volume — until then all rallies are technical, not fundamental.
watchNext.zh: 能否在放量下以日线收复 $5.96(DAO 销毁隐含公允价);在此之前,任何反弹都是技术性的,而非基本面驱动。

watchNext.en: Any forum movement toward a real-yield / staker fee-redirect RFC — still the single largest structural rerating catalyst for UNI.
watchNext.zh: 论坛上任何 real-yield / 费用向 staker 分流 RFC 的推进迹象——仍是 UNI 结构性重定价的最大单一催化剂。

fullReasoning.en: UNI is up 14.15% on the week and 7.71% on the day, but neither the fundamentals nor positioning justify continuation. Annualized protocol revenue of $77.41M produces a $13.16M buyback budget — enough to remove ~3.01M UNI/year against 20M in emissions. The token is still structurally +1.70% inflationary, and price sits 27% below the DAO's own $5.96 treasury burn anchor — the market is refusing to mark UNI where the DAO itself paid. This is a rally without a resolved catalyst. Two potentially accretive proposals — v4 Protocol Fees activation and Robinhood Chain fee expansion — are still in temp check, meaning weeks away at best. Derivatives echo the same skepticism: $24.25M OI on a $2.75B market cap is thin, funding is flat at +0.01%, and a 1.65 L/S ratio shows retail already leaning the direction the tape just rewarded. Most importantly, the real-yield staker-redirect RFC — the single largest rerating variable — has no visible forum momentum. Without it, UNI remains a PE-multiple governance token with net dilution. Base case: stall below $5.96 and mean reversion toward the $3.50-4.00 zone unless v4 fees moves to Snapshot. Trade the range. Do not chase the breakout.
fullReasoning.zh: UNI 单周 +14.15%、单日 +7.71%,但基本面与持仓结构都不支持延续。年化协议收入 $77.41M 对应 $13.16M 的 buyback 预算,按现价年销毁约 3.01M UNI,远不足以对冲 20M 的年度增发。代币结构上仍处于 +1.70%/年 的净通胀状态,现价较 DAO 自己认定的 $5.96 国库销毁锚点仍折价 27%——市场明确拒绝把 UNI 标在 DAO 自己出价的水平之上。这是一波没有落地催化剂的反弹。论坛端两项潜在利好——v4 Protocol Fees 激活与 Robinhood Chain 费用扩张——仍停留在 temp check 阶段,最快也需数周才能进入正式投票。衍生品端同样印证疑虑:$2.75B 市值上仅有 $24.25M OI,funding 仅 +0.01%,L/S 1.65 说明散户已经站在了刚刚上涨的方向。更关键的是,real-yield / 向 staker 分流费用的 RFC——UNI 最大的单一重定价变量——在论坛上毫无推进迹象。缺少它,UNI 只是一个净稀释、按 PE 倍数定价的治理代币。基准情形:在 $5.96 下方停滞,并向 $3.50-4.00 区间均值回归,除非 v4 fees 推进到 Snapshot 投票。区间交易,不要追突破。
